parts.name: Become a HERO
parts.desc: Goal: 35. After an ally monster attacks and kills an enemy monster, gain a counter for all excess DMG dealt. Reward: Equip _The Shadow Mantle_.

parts.name: The Shadow Mantle
parts.desc: Turn end: Draw a monster and give it +2/+1. If it cost 6+ G, also give it Darkspawn. Shock: Add a {Friendling} to the enemy deck.

parts.name: Mantle Holder
parts.desc: Haste. Darkspawn. Quest: _Become a HERO_. Magic and Turn start: Add a {Friendling} to the top of the enemy deck.

parts.name: Friendling
parts.desc: Darkspawn. Magic: Draw a card. Dust: If this was killed by an enemy monster, give it Candy.

parts.name: Honey
parts.desc: After the monster on this slot attacks, if it is damaged, heal 2 HP to it and this effect expires.

parts.name: Honey Cooler
parts.desc: Magic: Enchant all ally slots with _Honey_.

parts.name: Honeybear
parts.desc: Support: Enchant the attacker's slot with _Honey_.

parts.name: Fortune Catti
parts.desc: Magic: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck and choose one. Erase it to draw 2 cards.

parts.name: Netskie
parts.desc: Magic: Enchant this slot with _Fluffy $$$$ing Tail_.

parts.name: Fluffy $$$$ing Tail
parts.desc: After a non-Charge non-DT monster is played, turn the monster on this slot into a copy of it with this monster's current stats. Turn end: If this slot is empty, this effect expires.

parts.name: Garden Fox
parts.desc: Magic: Turn into a copy of a non-DT monster with this monster's stats.
